name: Countdown Protocol: Doomsday
description: A story-first route through the 15 projects in Disney+’s Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday collection, with Loki split into its two season records and an optional animated mutant briefing from the archive.

sections.name: Mutant legacy
sections.description: Meet the original live-action X-Men whose history and fault lines now intersect with the Avengers.

items.rationale: Introduces Xavier, Magneto, Cyclops, Jean Grey, Storm, Mystique, and the first Fox X-Men status quo.
Deepens the Xavier–Magneto alliance and brings Nightcrawler into the returning ensemble.

sections.name: Avengers foundation
sections.description: The essential spine of the Infinity Saga: Steve Rogers, the team’s formation, Thanos, and the cost of Endgame.

items.rationale: Establishes Steve Rogers, the Super Soldier legacy, and the Tesseract thread that carries into the Avengers story.
Forms the original Avengers and establishes Loki’s first collision with Earth’s heroes.
Converges the Avengers, Wakanda, and the cosmic heroes around Thanos and the Infinity Stones.
Resolves the Infinity Saga while creating the post-Blip world and time-travel consequences inherited by Doomsday.

sections.name: Multiverse rules
sections.description: Learn how branches, variants, incursions, and cross-universe visitors work before worlds begin to collide.

items.rationale: Introduces the TVA, variants, branching timelines, and the breakdown of the controlled timeline.
Completes Loki’s TVA journey and establishes the multiversal structure in place before Doomsday.
Introduces Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings, one of the unresolved signals carried into the next Avengers era.
Shows a spell tearing open barriers between screen universes and makes legacy heroes part of the MCU’s present.
Defines incursions and dreamwalking while demonstrating the danger of one universe colliding with another.

sections.name: The new board
sections.description: Catch up with the teams, nations, and heroes positioned to answer the next global and multiversal crisis.

items.rationale: Places Shuri, M’Baku, Wakanda, Namor, and Talokan in the post-T’Challa world.
Establishes Sam Wilson’s Captain America and the geopolitical conditions surrounding the next Avengers response.
Connects the TVA to the Fox mutant legacy and makes cross-universe survival a character-level problem.
Assembles the New Avengers and defines the uneasy team entering the Doomsday crisis.
Introduces the Fantastic Four, their retro-futurist home universe, and the family central to Doom’s arrival.

sections.name: Archive bonus: animated mutants
sections.description: Not part of Disney+’s 15-project studio list, but the fastest route to the X-Men’s animated vocabulary and the ’97 revival.

items.rationale: The 1990s series supplies the visual language, team dynamics, and multiverse stories that X-Men ’97 directly continues.
items.selectionNote: Watch: Night of the Sentinels I–II, Days of Future Past I–II, and One Man’s Worth I–II.

items.rationale: A concise modern refresher on mutant politics, team relationships, and catastrophic threats across time.
items.selectionNote: Watch the complete first season after the six selected 1990s episodes.
